name: terrain-from-data
summary: Build a Terrain (hills, a worn road, clearings, markers) from a layout written as plain functions and lists.
adapt: Edit Assets/Editor/Gam3/Gam3Layout.cs: roads, clearings, the knoll, markers, colours, size.
Let Unity create the .meta files on the next open or compile, then commit them with the scripts.
Replace the plain-colour TerrainLayers with textured ones when you have art; the builder re-assigns its own layers on every run, so change Layer() or stop calling it.
verify: node Tools/gam3/unity_run.mjs exec Gam3.Shot.Capture -- -gam3Scene Assets/Gam3World/World.unity -gam3Out Shots/world.png   (needs the shot-capture kit)

verified.how: Built the sample layout in batch mode in a new built-in-pipeline project, rebuilt it in place three times, captured it with shot-capture and checked the images: hills, the road with its fork and a clearing are visible. URP and HDRP not run.
